articles.title: Palmer & Rice among five withdrawals from England squad
articles.summary: Tino Livramento, Kobbie Mainoo, Cole Palmer, Marcus Rashford and Declan Rice all pull out of England's squad for forthcoming Nations League matches.

articles.title: How is Scotland squad shaping up for Pocognoli debut?
articles.summary: Sebastien Pocognoli's faces his first test as Scotland head coach against Slovenia on Saturday, but how are his squad shaping up for his debut?

articles.title: Wilson, Darlow and Broadhead out of Wales squad
articles.summary: Wales suffer a triple blow before their Nations League A campaign with Harry Wilson, Nathan Broadhead and Karl Darlow all out of Craig Bellamy's squad.
